tasks.title: Measure the O_EXCL coexistence fact, then record 'ownership stays in the filename' (body rejected) in DECISIONS.md
tasks.specExcerpt:
1. Decide filename-vs-body ownership. The decision must weigh: the six hand-copied readers, the builtin-only constraint, the O_EXCL open in ops-task.sh, the legacy migration in ops-sessionstart-hook.sh, and that an unowned sentinel must keep failing CLOSED. Record the decision and the rejected option in DECISIONS.md.
2. If body ownership wins: change ops-task.sh, ops-adopt.sh and ops-verdict.sh to write the field, and the three readers' sentinel_owner_of_name() to read it, keeping the bounded read and the `-L` before `-f` type test.
NORTH STAR: Sentinel ownership lives where six readers and three writers agree on it, and the Stop gate still blocks on mine + unowned. Missed if: any reader and writer disagree on an owner, or an unowned sentinel stops blocking.
steps: Branch from main in the repo root: `cd /Users/redux/Documents/Development/repos/cc-operator-plugin && git fetch origin && git checkout -b feat/sentinel-ownership-decision origin/main`. Do not commit on main. Open a tracked task: `.operator/bin/ops-task.sh sentinel-ownership --owner <your session id from the SessionStart banner>`.

Record baseline: `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -5` (run it ALONE — the shell suite is not concurrency-safe) and `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?`. Write down the passed/failed/skipped counts.

PROBE the load-bearing fact (the decision rests on it): `T=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$T" && git init -q && bash /Users/redux/Documents/Development/repos/cc-operator-plugin/scripts/ops-init.sh` (read ops-init.sh's `# Usage:` header first for required args). Then `.operator/bin/ops-task.sh t --owner A; .operator/bin/ops-task.sh t --owner B; ls -la .operator/pending/`. EXPECT two regular files `A__t` and `B__t`. Save the exact output. If the output is anything else (one file, or ops-task.sh reports 'already open' for B), STOP and report — the decision below is then unfounded.

PROBE the unowned fail-closed path: `: > .operator/pending/u` then pipe a Stop payload to the hook as the existing 'sentinel ownership' cases do (`grep -n 'sentinel ownership' /Users/redux/Documents/Development/repos/cc-operator-plugin/tests/test-scripts.sh` to copy the stdin JSON shape) with session_id C; EXPECT exit 2. Save output. `rm -rf "$T"` only after viewing it (it is your own mktemp dir).

Read `templates/DECISIONS-header.md` and `grep -n 'DECISIONS_RECORD_KINDS\|DECISIONS_GATED_KINDS' scripts/validate_plugin.py`. Pick a kind from DECISIONS_RECORD_KINDS (a GATED kind would arm the deviation gate and block Stop). Match the column format of existing rows in `.operator/DECISIONS.md`.

Append ONE row. Content (fit it to the table cells): DECISION: sentinel ownership stays in the FILENAME (`pending/<sid>__<task>`); REJECTED: body field `owner=<sid>`. WHY (each measured or cited): (a) O_EXCL — ops-task.sh opens `pending/<sid>__<task>` with O_EXCL, so two sessions on one task id hold two sentinels (probe output: A__t, B__t); a body-owned `pending/<task>` makes the second open hit the else-branch 'pre-existing regular file = already open, exit 0' and silently JOIN a foreign task — a writer/reader owner disagreement, the North Star's miss condition. (b) ops-adopt.sh re-stamps by atomic rename; body ownership needs write-temp+rename per adopt plus a partial-write window. (c) builtin-only readers (ops-stop-hook.sh, statusline.sh) would have to open every sentinel under statusline's ~300ms budget (CR5), and the body — today tested as UNTRUSTED input ('sentinel BODY is untrusted input' cases) — would become the ownership key. (d) ops-sessionstart-hook.sh would need a SECOND legacy migration (filename-owned → body-owned) on top of the pre-0.4 one, another six-site reject-set copy. (e) Fail-closed is preserved as-is: an unowned `pending/<task>` blocks (probe exit 2). The six hand-copied parsers stay pinned by check_guard_parity; the cost is accepted, not removed.

Verify the row did not arm the gate: pipe a Stop payload with your session id to `scripts/ops-stop-hook.sh` from the repo root; expect no deviation block attributable to the new row. `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` → rc=0 (same as baseline).

`git check-ignore -v .operator/DECISIONS.md` — if ignored, note it: the CHANGELOG entry (task version-bump) carries the decision text into tracked history. If tracked: `git add .operator/DECISIONS.md && git commit -m 'Decide: sentinel ownership stays in the filename; body field rejected'`.
tasks.testCycle: Probe: `ls .operator/pending/` in the temp project prints `A__t` and `B__t`; unowned Stop probe exits 2. Then `grep -c 'owner=<sid>' .operator/DECISIONS.md` ≥ 1 (the rejected option is named) and `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` prints rc=0.

tasks.title: Red-first case: an OWNED sentinel is agreed on by writer, gate, bar and closer
files: tests/test-scripts.sh (new case block, placed directly after the existing 'sentinel ownership' case block — locate with `grep -n 'sentinel ownership' tests/test-scripts.sh`)
produces: Case: sentinel owner agreement — OWNED blocks its owner
tasks.specExcerpt:
3. Add red-first cases to tests/test-scripts.sh for: owned, unowned (blocks), foreign (reports).
5. Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env by the number of cases added.
CLAUDE.md: 'a suite's case count (adding or deleting cases) → raise the matching FLOOR_* in tests/floors.env in the SAME commit. It is a FLOOR (>=) over passed+skipped.' 'A new test proves nothing until it FAILS on the pre-fix code.' Ownership is filename-encoded: `pending/<sid>__<task>` owned; Stop hook blocks on mine + unowned, reports foreign.
steps: Read the existing 'sentinel ownership' case block and the helpers it uses (`check`, `skip`, fixture setup, how it pipes the Stop JSON and runs `scripts/statusline.sh`). Reuse them verbatim — do not invent a new harness.

Write the case, header `echo "-- Case: sentinel owner agreement — OWNED blocks its owner"`, in a fresh fixture project. Checks: (1) `ops-task.sh t --owner S1` creates regular file `pending/S1__t` and nothing else in pending/; (2) Stop hook with session_id S1 exits 2 and its message names `t`; (3) statusline.sh fed session S1 reports it in the BLOCKING/mine segment (assert the exact token the existing statusline cases assert); (4) `ops-verdict.sh t PASS ... --owner S1` (copy the flag set from an existing verdict case) exits 0 and `pending/S1__t` is gone.

RED FIRST in an ISOLATED copy (parallel mutate/restore corrupts results): `M=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R /Users/redux/Documents/Development/repos/cc-operator-plugin "$M/r" && cd "$M/r"`. Mutate `sentinel_owner_of_name` in scripts/lib/partition.sh (find with `grep -n 'sentinel_owner_of_name' scripts/lib/partition.sh`) to return the TASK half instead of the owner half (e.g. `${name#*__}` where it had `${name%%__*}`). Run `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | grep -A6 'OWNED blocks its owner'`. EXPECT checks (2) and (3) FAIL. Record the output. If they pass, the mutation missed — fix the mutation, not the case.
Run the real tree ALONE: `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -5`. EXPECT failed count = baseline, passed+skipped = baseline + delta. Note the delta in the unit the summary counts.

Raise `FLOOR_SHELL` in tests/floors.env by that delta (it equals 1 when the counted unit is cases). Run `bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell; echo rc=$?` → rc=0, and `shellcheck tests/test-scripts.sh` → clean (CI runs shellcheck first).
`git add tests/test-scripts.sh tests/floors.env && git commit -m 'test: owned sentinel is agreed by writer, gate, bar and closer (red-first)'`.
tasks.testCycle: Mutated copy: `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | grep -A6 'OWNED blocks its owner'` shows FAIL on the Stop-exit-2 and statusline checks. Real tree: `bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell; echo rc=$?` prints rc=0 with failed count unchanged from baseline.

tasks.title: Red-first case: an UNOWNED sentinel blocks every session (fail closed)
files: tests/test-scripts.sh (new case block directly after the OWNED case)
produces: Case: sentinel owner agreement — UNOWNED blocks every session
consumes: Case: sentinel owner agreement — OWNED blocks its owner
tasks.specExcerpt:
3. Add red-first cases to tests/test-scripts.sh for: owned, unowned (blocks), foreign (reports).
5. Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env by the number of cases added.
CLAUDE.md: 'Unowned fails closed — that is what keeps pre-0.4 empty sentinels gating, and it is deliberately the opposite default from the no-parser fail-open in the same file.' `pending/<task>` is unowned. Missed if: an unowned sentinel stops blocking.
steps: Write `echo "-- Case: sentinel owner agreement — UNOWNED blocks every session"` in a fresh fixture, reusing the OWNED case's helpers. Create the pre-0.4 shape: `: > .operator/pending/t` (empty regular file). Checks: (1) Stop hook with session_id S1 exits 2; (2) Stop hook with session_id S2 also exits 2; (3) statusline.sh for S1 counts it as BLOCKING; (4) `ops-adopt.sh --owner S1 t` renames it to `pending/S1__t` (regular file, `pending/t` gone) — the writer and readers agree on the new owner.

RED FIRST in an isolated copy (`M=$(mktemp -d) && cp -R <repo> "$M/r"`): in scripts/lib/partition.sh's pending scan, route the unowned bucket to foreign (make the empty-owner branch take the foreign path). `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | grep -A6 'UNOWNED blocks every session'` — EXPECT checks (1)-(3) FAIL. Record it.
Real tree, run ALONE: `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -5` → failed = baseline; note the passed+skipped delta.
Raise FLOOR_SHELL by that delta. `bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell; echo rc=$?` → rc=0; `shellcheck tests/test-scripts.sh` clean.
`git add tests/test-scripts.sh tests/floors.env && git commit -m 'test: unowned sentinel blocks every session (red-first)'`.
tasks.testCycle: Mutated copy: the UNOWNED case's Stop-exit-2 checks FAIL. Real tree: `bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell; echo rc=$?` prints rc=0, failed count unchanged from baseline.

tasks.title: Red-first case: a FOREIGN sentinel is reported, never blocks, and cannot be closed by a non-owner
files: tests/test-scripts.sh (new case block directly after the UNOWNED case)
produces: Case: sentinel owner agreement — FOREIGN reports, never blocks
consumes: Case: sentinel owner agreement — UNOWNED blocks every session
tasks.specExcerpt:
3. Add red-first cases to tests/test-scripts.sh for: owned, unowned (blocks), foreign (reports).
5. Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env by the number of cases added.
CLAUDE.md: 'ops-stop-hook.sh blocks on mine + unowned and merely reports foreign.' ops-verdict.sh's ownership_gate is the single choke point refusing a non-owner before any write.
steps: Write `echo "-- Case: sentinel owner agreement — FOREIGN reports, never blocks"` in a fresh fixture. `ops-task.sh t --owner S2` → `pending/S2__t`. Checks: (1) Stop hook with session_id S1 exits 0 AND its output mentions the foreign task as informational (assert the exact wording the existing foreign case asserts); (2) statusline.sh for S1 does NOT count it as BLOCKING; (3) `ops-verdict.sh t PASS ... --owner S1` exits non-zero and VERDICTS.md is unchanged — use `unchanged_lines`/`unchanged_bytes`, never a bare `=` between two reads (absent both read `""`); (4) `pending/S2__t` still exists.

RED FIRST in an isolated copy: mutate scripts/lib/partition.sh so a foreign owner is classified as mine. `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | grep -A6 'FOREIGN reports, never blocks'` — EXPECT checks (1)-(2) FAIL. Separately (fresh copy) mutate ops-verdict.sh's `ownership_gate` to `return 0` first line; EXPECT checks (3)-(4) FAIL. Record both.
Real tree, run ALONE: `bash tests/test-scripts.sh 2>&1 | tail -5` → failed = baseline; note delta.
Raise FLOOR_SHELL by that delta. `bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell; echo rc=$?` → rc=0; `shellcheck tests/test-scripts.sh` clean.
`git add tests/test-scripts.sh tests/floors.env && git commit -m 'test: foreign sentinel reports, never blocks, cannot be closed by a non-owner (red-first)'`.
tasks.testCycle: Both mutated copies show the FOREIGN case's targeted checks FAIL. Real tree: `bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell; echo rc=$?` prints rc=0, failed count unchanged from baseline.

CLAUDE.md: '`plugin.json` `version` → add the matching `## [x.y.z]` as the newest heading in CHANGELOG.md, same commit (the release gate fails otherwise).'
steps: `grep -rn '"version"' .claude-plugin/` — confirm current is 0.12.13 and whether marketplace.json also carries a version; if it does, bump it too and say so in the commit.

RED FIRST: set plugin.json version to 0.13.0 WITHOUT touching CHANGELOG; run the release gate (`ls scripts/ | grep -i release` to find it, e.g. `python3 scripts/release_gate.py`) and `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py`. EXPECT a failure naming the missing 0.13.0 heading. Record it.

Add `## [0.13.0]` as the newest heading in CHANGELOG.md, matching the existing heading format (date form included). Body: the decision (ownership stays in the filename; body `owner=<sid>` rejected, with reasons a–e from the DECISIONS row in one line each) and the three new cases by title. This makes the decision tracked even if .operator/DECISIONS.md is gitignored.

Re-run release gate and `python3 scripts/validate_plugin.py; echo rc=$?` → both rc=0. Then the full ladder ALONE: `bash scripts/gate-suite.sh shell`, and `shellcheck scripts/*.sh scripts/lib/*.sh tests/*.sh`. Report delta vs task decide-ownership's baseline.

`git add .claude-plugin/plugin.json CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m 'v0.13.0: sentinel ownership stays in the filename; owner-agreement cases'`. Close the tracked task with ops-verdict.sh PASS --owner <sid> citing the gate output. Push only with `git push -u origin feat/sentinel-ownership-decision`.
